landing.heroIntro: Book appointments in seconds, get reminders, and skip the queues — online, by SMS, or at the front desk, even without internet.
landing.stat1Label: Clinics & hospital networks on one system
landing.stat2Label: Online, SMS, USSD and front desk
landing.feature1Text: Pick a facility, department, doctor and a free time slot in a few taps. Slots are locked instantly so double bookings never happen.
landing.feature2Text: Doctors manage working hours, breaks and leave days — the available slots update automatically.
landing.feature3Text: Run a single clinic or an entire hospital network from one dashboard with role-based access.
landing.howSubtitle: From registering to being seen in four simple steps.
landing.step1Text: Register as a patient in under a minute with your email or national ID.
landing.step2Text: Choose your clinic, department and the right doctor for your visit.
landing.step3Text: See only real available slots and confirm your appointment instantly.
landing.step4Text: Arrive at the desk, check in, and follow your queue number to the doctor.
landing.rolesSubtitle: Patients, doctors and hospital staff each get a tailored experience.
landing.rolePatientText: Take control of your care from anywhere.

landing.patientItem2: View all upcoming visits in one place
landing.patientItem3: Book by phone or SMS when you have no internet

landing.modulesSubtitle: Everything your facility needs — from booking to lab results — in one integrated system.
landing.module1Text: Book appointments in real-time with conflict-free slot management, queue tracking, and automated reminders.
landing.module2Text: Capture vitals, diagnoses, and treatment notes in structured digital records accessible across your team.
landing.module3Text: Issue prescriptions with allergy cross-checks, generate printable PDFs, and track dispensing status.
landing.module4Text: Track drug stock levels, batch numbers, expiry dates, and dispense with atomic inventory updates.
landing.module5Text: Request tests, enter results, flag abnormals, and share findings with the treating doctor instantly.
landing.module6Text: Role-based access, full audit trails, and rate limiting keep patient data safe and compliance-ready.
landing.testimonial: HAS transformed how we manage patient flow. No more paper queues — everything is digital, fast, and reliable.
landing.footerText: Hospital Appointments Management System. Built for Rwanda's healthcare.
landing.aboutText1: HAS streamlines hospital appointments across Rwanda by connecting patients, doctors, and facilities on a single digital platform. Whether you walk into a reception or book from your phone, every appointment is tracked, queued, and delivered without the paper.
landing.aboutText2: We believe every Rwandan deserves fast, reliable access to healthcare — from urban hospitals to rural health centers. Our system works online and offline, via SMS, USSD, and the web.

help.title: How can we help?
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions patients and staff ask us most often.
help.byEmailText: Send us the details and we will reply within one working day.
help.byPhoneText: Call us during opening hours for booking help.
help.hoursText: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. Saturday, 08:00 to 12:00.
help.topicsSubtitle: Pick a topic, or jump straight to the answers.
help.qBookSlot: How do I book an appointment?
help.aBookSlot: Create a patient account, choose your facility and department, then pick from the slots your doctor has published. The slot is locked to you as soon as you confirm.
help.aCancelSlot: Yes. Open Appointments, select the visit and choose Cancel. The slot returns to your doctor's availability straight away.
help.qReschedule: How do I move an appointment to another day?
help.aReschedule: Cancel the existing visit first, then book a new slot. We do not carry the original booking across, so nothing is double-booked.
help.aNoSlots: Doctors publish their own hours. If a day looks empty, the schedule for that day may not be open yet. Try a nearby date or another doctor.
help.qForgotPassword: I forgot my password. What now?
help.aForgotPassword: Use the Forgot password link on the login screen and we will send a reset link to your email or SMS. You can also sign in with your national ID instead.
help.qNationalId: Why do you need my national ID?
help.aNationalId: It is the national identifier used to match you to your health records. It is a required alternative to email at sign-in and is stored only for identification.
help.qChangeEmail: Can I change the email on my account?
help.aChangeEmail: Yes. Sign in and open Settings to update your contact details. Your national ID, once registered, cannot be changed.
help.qOtp: I did not get my verification code.
help.aOtp: Check your spam folder and confirm your phone number is correct. Codes expire after a few minutes, so request a new one if it has been a while.
help.qDataStored: What information do you store about me?
help.aDataStored: Your name, contact details, national ID, appointments and any records your care team files. Clinical notes stay with the treating facility.
help.aShareData: Only the clinicians involved in your care, and administrators at your facility. Access is role-based and every view is written to an audit log.
help.qRecords: Where do I find my results?
help.aRecords: Under Documents and Lab results once your care team publishes them. Prescriptions and medical history live in their own sections.
help.aNoInternet: Yes. Use USSD or SMS from any phone, or ask for help at the front desk, and the booking will be linked to your account.
help.qSmsUssd: How do USSD and SMS booking work?
help.aSmsUssd: Dial the USSD code or send the keyword to the number on your poster. Follow the prompts to pick a facility, doctor and slot.
help.aLanguages: The interface is available in English, French and Kinyarwanda. Switch language from Settings or from the language menu in the navbar.

legal.questionsText: Our support team can explain any part of it.
legal.dataText: Contact details, national ID, appointments and clinical records created by your care team.
legal.useText: To deliver your care, manage bookings and keep the service running.
legal.accessText: Clinicians treating you and administrators at your facility, under role-based access.
legal.securityText: Role-based access, encrypted transport and an audit trail of every record view.
legal.privacyIntro: How HAS collects, uses and protects your personal and health information.
legal.p_collect: We collect the details you give us when you register: your name, email address, phone number and national ID. Clinical information is added by the professionals who treat you, not collected from you directly. We also record basic technical data such as login times and audit events so we can investigate problems and protect accounts.
legal.p_use: Your information is used to identify you, match you to your health records, manage appointments, send reminders and provide support. It is not used for advertising, and it is not sold to third parties. Where we are legally required to disclose information, we will tell you unless doing so would put your safety or another patient's rights at risk.
legal.p_share: Your records are visible to clinicians involved in your care and to administrators at the facility that treats you. Access follows the least-privilege principle: staff see only what their role requires. Every access is written to an audit log that administrators can review. We do not share identifiable patient data with insurers, employers or researchers without your consent.
legal.p_retention: We keep health records for as long as your care requires, and for the retention period the law prescribes. Account information is kept while your account is active. If you close your account, identifying details are removed and only the records your facility is legally required to retain remain.
legal.p_rights: You can ask what we hold about you, request a correction, or ask us to delete your account. Some records cannot be deleted while they are needed for your care or required by law, and we will explain which apply. You can also ask who has viewed your records.
legal.p_security: Data is encrypted in transit. Access is granted by role and revoked when a role changes. Administrative actions are logged, and the logs are themselves protected from modification. We review access patterns for unusual activity.
legal.p_contact: Questions about this policy can go to the support address listed in the footer, or be raised at any front desk. If you are not satisfied with how we handled your information, you may escalate it with the relevant authority.
legal.termsIntro: The terms that apply when you use HAS to book and manage appointments.
legal.doText: Give accurate details, keep your credentials secure, and tell us promptly if something is wrong.
legal.dontText: Sharing accounts, booking under another person's identity, or misusing the system to disrupt care.
legal.riskText: We work to keep the platform available, but slots and services depend on the facilities using it.
legal.tp_acceptance: By creating an account or booking through HAS you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, please do not use the platform. We may update these terms; material changes will be announced in the product.
legal.tp_appointments: A booking confirms a place in a published slot, not a clinical outcome. Availability is set by each doctor. Cancellations made inside the facility's notice window may be recorded on your record. Very late cancellations repeated many times may lead to a booking restriction.
legal.tp_accounts: You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping your password confidential. Register only once, and tell us if you believe someone else has access to your account. We may suspend accounts used fraudulently or to cause harm to staff or other patients.
legal.tp_obligations: Do not attempt to access records belonging to other people, interfere with the operation of the service, or use it to harass staff. Automated bulk access and scraping of patient data are not permitted.
legal.tp_fees: Registration and booking through HAS are free. Consultation and investigation fees are set by the treating facility and are collected at that facility. HAS does not set or collect clinical fees.
legal.tp_liability: HAS provides a booking and records platform. Clinical care is delivered by the treating professionals, whose decisions govern your treatment. We aim to keep the service accurate and available but do not warrant uninterrupted operation, and we are not liable for decisions made by treating clinicians.
legal.tp_changes: We may revise these terms as the service develops. The date at the top of this page always reflects the current version, and continued use after an update means the revised terms apply to you.
